description: An empty alg is refused with UnsupportedAlgorithm, not treated as absent; decided by ADR 0054 §1.1: the empty string is no algorithm polyjose implements, so the alg setter refuses it; only an absent alg skips the alg checks (§2); outcome hand-derived from the ADR 0054 text (conformance/tools/jwk-oracle/specs/select.json), never computed by polyjose
